cpu.note: The main thread is throttled to runnerScore / slowdown on the CPU_SCORE workload in bench.mjs. runnerScore is what a GitHub ubuntu-latest runner scores unthrottled; slowdown is how much slower than that runner the target phone is assumed to be (iPhone X A11: ~1.3x by single-core benchmarks, plus mobile-Safari overhead). Every run re-measures its own machine and throttles to the same target, so the result doesn't depend on which runner you get. Raise slowdown to make the budget tighter.
